author: Astrokillah
text:
Edge wrote: For those price
nerds like me who enjoy the puzzle more than the trading. This is an
exercise I like to do. Almost like a sports team at half time. Who is
leading. Which kink has more chances of success with clean orders
(caveat - not a strategy within itself but shows which kink has the
probability of winning? Anyone want to have a shot at who is leading at
half time. is it RED or GREEN (remember this is only one factor and is
not worthy of trading as a strategy in of itself).HINT - it has nothing
to do with what price is doing in between the kinks

Hello Edge,

Congratulation on your promotion! I'm a newbie here, been reading and
reading, at the moment my brain is completely messed up, especially with
 so many pieces scattering all over the places (SD, SR, DP, FL, FTR,
PAZ). So let me attempt this quiz of yours, price history is telling me
this:

- All the clean orders inside the Green FL have been grabbed, price left
 the area, went north for a long time before coming back down, creating
the RED FL.

- But price dropped a little too fast from the RED FL, leaving unfilled orders at its MPL.

- ITs are not going to leave those orders behind, so they will find a way to get it.

- However, ITs have not yet shown us their true intent! Price is
bouncing between two FL, until one of them is engulfed, I don't know how
 to guess the true intent of the ITs.

What we know is:

- If price gets to the MPL of the RED FL, it is likely to turn around -
the question is how far? For example, I draw one of the many
possibilities below:

- Also, if price get to the bottom of GREEN FL, there is no more clean orders remaining, so price can easily engulf south.

Thank you very much!

AK

I am not edge, but from what I understand in my point of view is

Ignored levels = Swap levels and levels with orders because price did not RT enough to fill them

In simple words I understand them as potential places for taking trades in confluence with PA :D

To answer you question, ignored levels play significant role as
eventually they will be respected. I remember in one of the Ifmyante
posts he posted some charts pointing this out. As for when it will be
respected, you cannot know :D. We can only mark them as interest areas
and watch PA.

Dengaima

author: Edge
text:
Each level should pick up clean orders and hit first opposing TG. If
it blasts through or only has a tiny retrace without hitting first TG, I
 consider it ignored. We need to ask ourselves why it has not reacted as
 expected :)
